name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
monetization: Largest US bank; monetizes AI as lead arranger of data-center project debt (Vantage $38B, Stargate Abilene construction loans) and margin/bridge lending against AI equity stakes (SoftBank) — while its research sizes the AI debt market it is building.
description_md: JPMorgan Chase is the largest US bank and the lead arranger of record for AI infrastructure credit: it co-led the biggest AI project-debt package to date (Vantage, $38B) and the construction financing for Stargate's flagship Abilene campus. Its research desk was among the first to size total AI-linked debt at ~$1.2T, calling it the largest sector in the US investment-grade market.
ai_monetization_md: AI-exposure thesis: arrange, warehouse briefly, and distribute the AI debt wave — earning league-table fees at every layer. Positions: co-lead (with MUFG) of the $38B senior secured facilities for Vantage's Texas/Wisconsin campuses that Oracle will use for OpenAI (Oct 2025); lead on the $2.3B and $7.1B construction loans for the Crusoe/Blue Owl/Primary Digital Stargate Abilene JV; JPMorgan Chase Bank is in SoftBank's $10B margin loan collateralized by its OpenAI stake (Aug 2026) after the earlier $40B bridge for the same investment.
risk_notes_md: Underwriting-to-distribution works until it doesn't: bridge and warehouse exposure concentrates at exactly the moments credit appetite turns (US banks' retreat from the Saline Township deal is the live example). The bank's own research estimate of ~$1.2T of AI-linked debt is an analyst figure, not a disclosure, and is one of the most-cited numbers in the systemic-risk debate — Chicago Fed analysis separately puts bank C&I commitments to AI-adjacent industries near 25% of Tier 1 capital.
